baselines.label: Fixed Harness + ReAct
baselines.paper_title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
baselines.definition: The decision policy may choose current-batch actions, but Harness components, procedures and Skills are not persistently rewritten.

baselines.label: ReAct + Reflexion
baselines.paper_title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
baselines.definition: The Harness remains fixed while textual reflections are stored and made available to later batches.

baselines.label: General Self-Harness
baselines.definition: The same editable components and run records are exposed, but the LLM proposes local edits directly without dependency-guided joint search.

baselines.label: CurateEvo adaptation
baselines.paper_title: CurateEvo: Data-Curation Evolving for Agentic Post-Training
baselines.definition: Failure feedback modifies data-curation code while the remaining Harness protocol and task-training interface stay fixed.
baselines.adaptation_note: This is a long-horizon data-stream adaptation, not the original paper setting.

baselines.label: Independent component edit
baselines.definition: Only one Harness component is edited at a time; no dependency-aware joint proposal is allowed.

baselines.label: Random joint edit
baselines.definition: The same-size joint edit is selected without dependency guidance, under the same candidate and execution budget.

baselines.label: Dependency-aware joint edit
baselines.definition: Failure diagnosis and the Harness dependency graph determine a bounded component group, which is evaluated before acceptance.

baselines.label: One-batch candidate selection
baselines.definition: Candidate acceptance checks one development batch instead of the proposed three-batch continuation.

baselines.label: Three-batch candidate selection
baselines.definition: Candidate acceptance uses three successive development batches and keeps future test data hidden.

baselines.label: Same initial memory, no process update
baselines.definition: All methods receive the same initial experience material; only persistent Harness process changes are disabled.

baselines.label: DataEvolver adaptation
baselines.paper_title: DataEvolver: Automatic Data Preparation for Large Language Models through Multi-Level Self-Evolving
baselines.definition: Adapt automatic data-preparation workflow improvement to the same streaming task and evaluation interface, documenting any changes from its original setting.
baselines.adaptation_note: Related-work comparison; not explicitly listed in the current required baseline table.

baselines.label: HarnessEvolve adaptation
baselines.paper_title: HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution
baselines.definition: Adapt current/recent-task update selection to the same data-stream branching protocol, distinguishing evaluation of existing tasks from evaluation of downstream data construction and training effects.
baselines.adaptation_note: Related-work comparison; ensure method and citation details are checked against the paper before implementation.
